sources.notes: CISA news index — broader announcements beyond formal advisories. WebFetch is reliably HTTP 403 on cisa.gov (re-confirmed 2026-05-08). REQUIRED FETCH METHOD: `python3 tools/fetch_source.py cisa page https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/news`. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → api/bridge: python3 tools/fetch_source.py cisa page https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/news (listing) then `cisa page <article_url>` for body. AVOID: WebFetch reliably HTTP 403 on cisa.gov — skip it entirely. Do not WebFetch any cisa.gov URL..

Swiss IT trade press; primary reporting on Swiss incidents (translate findings to English in brief). WebFetch returns HTTP 403 (re-confirmed 2026-05-08); the RSS feed at /feed.rss also 403's. REQUIRED FETCH METHOD: `python3 tools/fetch_source.py url https://www.inside-it.ch/`. | 2026-06-10: RSS bridge route https://www.inside-it.ch/rss.xml confirmed working via fetch_source.py url (resolves the prior 404 gap); no in-window security incidents on the feed this run. |. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → feed https://www.inside-it.ch/rss.xml 5 (via bridge; returns dated Swiss IT items, summary present) then bridge: python3 tools/fetch_source.py url <article-url> for body. Translate findings to English in the brief. AVOID: WebFetch 403s the homepage and the feed — skip WebFetch entirely. The old /feed.rss path 403'd historically; /rss.xml is the working feed.

SANS NewsBites — bi-weekly editorial newsletter. NO RSS. Recipe: `url https://www.sans.org/newsletters/newsbites/` to discover /newsletters/newsbites/<roman>-<no> hrefs, then `url <full>` per issue. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → webfetch (listing) https://www.sans.org/newsletters/newsbites/ to discover /newsletters/newsbites/{roman}-{no} issue hrefs, then webfetch https://www.sans.org/newsletters/newsbites/{roman}-{no} per issue. NO RSS.. AVOID: The listing may surface issue links on the web.prod.marketing.sans.services host — rewrite to the canonical www.sans.org/newsletters/newsbites/{roman}-{no} (it resolves and serves the full issue)..

Bruce Schneier; analytical/policy commentary. The /blog/ path now redirects to /. RSS at https://www.schneier.com/feed/atom/. (v2.55: rss_url verified — use `python3 tools/fetch_source.py feed https://www.schneier.com/feed/atom/ [N]`) | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → rss: python3 tools/fetch_source.py feed https://www.schneier.com/feed/atom/ 5 (then webfetch per-article URL for body). AVOID: The /blog/ path redirects to / — use the atom feed for the dated index. Largely analysis/policy/commentary, not breaking advisories — treat as context, not primary..

Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctions designations — primary source for sanctioning ransomware-cashout networks, bulletproof-host operators, and state-actor-affiliated infrastructure (added 2026-05-08). 2026-05-08 audit: WebFetch returned 5 dated designations May 1-7 2026. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → bridge: python3 tools/fetch_source.py url https://ofac.treasury.gov/recent-actions (listing of /recent-actions/YYYYMMDD entries) then bridge url https://ofac.treasury.gov/recent-actions/YYYYMMDD for the designation body. AVOID: Do NOT WebFetch — ofac.treasury.gov 503s the routine UA on both listing and detail. Use the bridge (browser UA) for both; it returns full HTML..

Discovered via S2 2026-05-22 research. Covers EU/UK CNI enforcement, ICS/OT vulnerability disclosures; published in-depth analysis of South Staffordshire ICO fine and utility cyber oversight implications. Candidate — promote to active after 3 runs with content contribution. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → webfetch https://industrialcyber.co (listing) then webfetch the per-article industrialcyber.co/<section>/<slug>/ for the full body. AVOID: Nothing to avoid — plain WebFetch works on both listing and articles. High publishing cadence (several items/day)..

Information Commissioner's Office breach announcements. WebFetch returns HTTP 403 (ICO filters the routine UA; re-confirmed 2026-05-08). REQUIRED FETCH METHOD: `python3 tools/fetch_source.py url https://ico.org.uk/about-the-ico/media-centre/news-and-blogs/`. For specific enforcement action listings use `python3 tools/fetch_source.py url https://ico.org.uk/action-weve-taken/enforcement/`. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → api: python3 tools/fetch_source.py ico-uk enforcement N  (returns enforcement URLs from sitemap; then `url <enforcement_url>` for body). News index via `url https://ico.org.uk/about-the-ico/media-centre/news-and-blogs/`.. AVOID: WebFetch 403s the routine UA — skip it, use the bridge. Article body text sits inside <main id='main-content'>; the page leads with a large cookie-banner JSON island so naive byte-range reads miss the body..
